## Grêmio probable line-up for Brasileirão trip to Remo

The Brasileirão resumes this week, and Grêmio visit Remo on Wednesday 7 at 19:30 Brasília time for round 29 at the Mangueirão in Belém.

Grêmio sit 17th on 29 points, two behind Vasco da Gama who have a game in hand. According to Gremistas.net, they are still seeking a first away win.

## OneFootball Videos [...] Renato Portaluppi has five confirmed absences. Full-backs Marlon and Diego Caito are nearing the end of injury recovery and are being prepared for the Gre-Nal next round.

Defender Gustavo Martins and Peru midfielder Noriega are suspended after third yellows in the 0-0 draw with Palmeiras before the international break. During the pause, Jovane Cabral suffered a grade 2 left-thigh muscle injury and also misses out.
